battle.name: 唐再奪東京之戰
battle.brief: 天平寶字元年（762）八月，藤原仲麻呂趁孝謙天皇崩、淳仁天皇即位之際舉兵，挾持光明皇太妃、火燒高松與大宮，直逼平安京。唐玄宗遣劉全真率唐兵及新羅、渤海之兵東渡，與大伴氏合兵，於京郊追擊，再於大和鄉間捕殺仲麻呂，東京重回朝廷之手。卡面的科林斯青銅盔不在此役序列，只作對照。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 這場戰爭發生在奈良時代末期的日本，戰場是京都的平安京與其南面的大和國盆地。叛方是藤原仲麻呂的私兵集團：以他本人為核心的藤原氏一門在畿內與諸國的依附者、數千名以私人身份召集的武人與傭兵，以及被他裹挾進來的僧侶禮僧。聖武天皇死後，仲麻呂先後取得太保、太師之號，朝廷的官署與律令體制仍照常運轉，但人事與兵權盡在他手，實質上就是攝政；他的力量不是國家軍隊，而是以人際網絡與私人武裝拼起來的幕府式結構。叛方沒有常備軍，兵員靠京都周邊豪族與各國國司臨時湊集，裝備多為大和弓、大刀、小刀與舊式皮甲，缺乏統一編制與後勤。朝廷方以淳仁天皇為名義，核心是大伴氏、大伴鯖等大伴一族率領的畿內武人，以及各國奉勅發來的勤王兵，效忠的象徵是被幽禁又脫身的光明皇太妃。外援方是唐帝國：唐玄宗遣安南大都護劉全真率唐兵，會同新羅與渤海國的船隊及兵員，經東海道海路第二次進入日本，於京郊與朝廷軍合流，這支部隊才是壓垮仲麻呂的真正力量。還有第四方，即朝中諸族在危機裡的站位：大伴氏因平叛之功得勢，藤原氏內部則因反目裂成兩半，另一部分藤原家人選擇支持朝廷，參與追捕自己的舊主。戰後記錄裡，渤海、新羅使節仍一批批到訪，日本與唐朝之間維持了數十年緊密的軍事與外交關係。
countriesEn: This war was fought in late Nara-period Japan, on the field of Heijō-kyō, the Kyoto of the time, and the Yamato basin to the south of it. The rebel side was the private armed group of Fujiwara no Nakamaro: dependents of the Fujiwara house in the capital districts and the provinces, several thousand retainers and mercenaries called in on short notice, and the monk Rōsō, whom he drew into the business. After the death of Emperor Shōmu, Nakamaro held first the taibu and then the taishi title; the court's offices and the ritsuryō apparatus kept running as before, but appointments and military authority were his to dispose of, and in effect he governed as regent. His strength was not a state army but a sort of shogunal structure assembled out of personal patronage and private retainers. The rebels had no standing force: their numbers were mustered from the private retainers of the great capital houses and of the provincial governors, armed mostly with yumi bows, tachi and short swords, and old leather armour, without unified organisation or logistics. The court side was nominally Emperor Junnin, and its core was the capital-region warriors of the Ōtomo clan — Ōtomo no Muraji, Ōtomo no Sake and their kin — together with levies summoned by the provincial governors, all answering to Empress Dowager Kōmyō. The external force was the Tang empire: Emperor Xuanzong sent the general Liu Quanzhen, then grand protector of Annan, with Tang troops and with contingents and ships from Silla and Balhae, who reached Japan for a second time by sea along the Tōkaidō and joined the court army outside the capital; it was this army that actually crushed Nakamaro. A fourth party was how the rest of the aristocracy positioned itself: the Ōtomo profited from the victory, and the Fujiwara house split against itself, with part of the clan choosing the court and helping to hunt down its own former chief. In the record that follows, envoys from Balhae and Silla kept arriving, and Japan held close military and diplomatic ties with Tang China for several decades.
people: 核心人物是藤原仲麻呂。他出身藤原不比等一門，父為藤原魚名，與先後兩任太師藤原房內同族，聖武天皇崩後與光明中宮、房內並立於朝，房內於741年病故後，仲麻呂獨攬朝政：他擁立傀儡皇子居於藤原宮，把皇太子與中宮幽禁在行在所，自己以太師身份攝政，又把自己的女兒立為孝謙天皇的中宮，並一度讓中宮之位空出、改立他人。此後最要命的一步，是他761年廢掉自己女兒的中宮之位，改立淳仁之妻、原已退居上皇的孝謙為中宮——這一舉同時逼反了自己的妹妹。妹妹光明皇太妃（原名藤原圓子，嫁刑部親王後為光明中宮之女）自此與他公開決裂。762年淳仁天皇即位，皇太妃到訪其居所時被僧侶禮僧挾持打算送入藤原宮，她逃出後直入藤原宮，向在日本的唐使求援，成為整場戰爭的轉折點。朝廷方的主角是大伴氏與大伴鯖等大伴氏族人，他們調集畿內武人自西山道壓進京都，與唐軍合流後一路追到大和，把仲麻呂逼入絕境。另一端的關鍵人物是唐將劉全真：758年第一次東渡的統帥，762年再度率軍入日，兩次遠征都由他主持，戰後受授安南大都護，留鎮倭國。往前追因果，還有太師藤原房內在二十多年前秘密遣使唐廷求援，754年唐使裴潛抵日、758年唐軍登陸，種下了這場戰爭的遠因；而戰後的尾巴則是765年底仲麻呂在宮中仍被源永手一系刺殺。
peopleEn: The central figure is Fujiwara no Nakamaro. He came from the Fujiwara line of Fujiwara no Fuhito, his father being Fujiwara no Uona, and was a kinsman of the two successive grand masters of the Taishi, Fujiwara no Fuhito II. After the death of Emperor Shōmu he stood at court beside Empress Kōmyō and Fuhito II; when Fuhito died in 741 Nakamaro took the government into his own hands: he set up a puppet prince in the Fujiwara palace, confined the crown prince and the empress in the temporary palace, ruled as regent under the taishi title, placed his own daughter as empress to Emperor Shōtoku, and at one point left the empress's seat empty in favour of another woman. The step that ruined him came in 761, when he deposed his own daughter as empress and installed Emperor Junnin's wife, the deposed Shōtoku, in her place — a move that turned his own sister against him. His sister, Empress Dowager Kōmyō (born Fujiwara no Enoko, daughter of Empress Kōmyō and consort of Prince Gyōbu), was from then on openly estranged from him. When Junnin took the throne in 762 and the empress dowager was seized by the monk Rōsō on her way to the Fujiwara palace, she broke free, took refuge in the Fujiwara palace and appealed to the Tang envoy then in Japan; that single act turned the whole war. On the court side the leading men were Ōtomo no Muraji and Ōtomo no Sake of the Ōtomo clan, who mustered the capital-region warriors and drove them down the western road into Kyoto, joined the Tang army and pursued Nakamaro into Yamato until he had nowhere left to go. At the other end stands the Tang general Liu Quanzhen, commander of the first crossing in 758 and of the second in 762, who afterwards was granted the title of grand protector of Annan and left in Japan as garrison commander. Further back in the causal chain lies Taishi Fujiwara no Fuhito II, who had secretly sent an embassy to the Tang court to ask for help two decades earlier, answered in 754 by the envoy Pei Qian and followed in 758 by the landing of Tang troops; and the tail of the story is Nakamaro's own murder in the palace at the end of 765 by the faction of Minamoto no Nagate.
kits: 本役實際出現的裝備分兩套系統。倭國一方是大和弓配石鏃玉、大刀與小刀、柄物長矛、革札甲、皮製或鐵製的開口護頭，以及短兵用的太刀柄；這些都是奈良時代京畿武人日常備用的東西，數量多、樣式雜，從町居武人到國司的部的雜兵都各備一套，難得整齊。徵發來的各國兵與大伴氏一族的畿內武人，主要靠大和弓在塀、門、巷口與寺社前做遮斷式射擊，再以短兵壓上；中繼站用驛馬與飛腳傳令。唐軍那一套則是唐的製式裝備：明光甲一類的前胸金屬護具、步人甲與皮甲、長槍、唐代直刀、弓與弩，以及隨軍的馬匹與軍用牛；新羅與渤海來的兵以弓兵、標槍手為主，靠船隊運載，並攜帶食糧。唐軍之所以能在京郊站住陣腳，靠的是長槍齊步、弩箭齊射與唐刀的近身纏鬥，而不是什麼奇技。卡面那頂科林斯青銅盔在這裡只作對照：它是約前650年前後的希臘青銅製全封閉面甲，眼孔只留兩條橫縫，這種形制在亞洲從未普及，奈良時代的日本戰士戴的是大鍔或皮盔，視野全開。面甲的邏輯是密集方陣裡的集體防護——戴它的人只能靠隊形活——但平安京城門前的巷戰、寺社門前的混戰、大和鄉間的逐村搜索都談不上方陣；在這種戰場上，一頂看不見的頭盔會讓人連自己人在哪裡都搞不清，寧可要一頂看得見周圍的開口盔。
kitsEn: Two equipment systems were actually present in this campaign. On the Japanese side were yumi bows with stone or jade arrowheads, tachi and short swords, polearm spears, leather lamellar armour, and open-faced helmets of leather or iron, together with the sword for close work; these were the everyday kit of the Nara-period warrior in the capital region, numerous in quantity and varied in pattern, with a different set carried by the merchant-town fighters and by the mixed levies of the provincial governors, and rarely uniform. The levies from the provinces and the capital-region Ōtomo warriors relied on yumi fire from behind walls, gates, lane mouths and temple precincts to cut and hold, and then sent in short weapons behind the arrow line; relay stations and mounted messengers carried the orders along the roads. The Tang army carried the equipment of its own army: front-plated armour of the Mingguang type, infantry armour and leather kit, long spears, Tang-style straight swords, bows and crossbows, together with horses and pack animals. The Silla and Balhae contingents were chiefly bowmen and javelin-armed, carried by their own shipping, and brought their own food. What let the Tang army hold its line outside Kyoto was the drilled long-spear ranks, the volley of crossbow bolts and the cutting of Tang straight swords in close fighting, not any exotic device. The Corinthian helmet on the card serves only as a comparison: it is a fully closed Greek bronze face-piece of about 650 BC with two narrow eye slits, a form never in use in Asia, while Nara-period Japanese fighters wore wide-brimmed or leather helmets that left the view open. The logic of the face-piece is collective protection inside a dense formation — the man who wears it can only live by the line — but the fighting at the gates of Heijō-kyō, the brawl at temple gates and the house-by-house search in the villages of Yamato were never a formation fight. In that kind of fight a helmet that cannot see is worse than useless, since the man does not even know where his own comrades stand; a helmet that can see all round is worth more.
tactics: 叛方的打法是突然、兇猛而缺乏縱深。仲麻呂於天平寶字元年八月起兵，先以京都一帶的私兵佔住宮禁與門樓，放火燒高松一帶的官舍與大宮的集落，並挾持光明皇太妃作旗號，把一場政變說成是救駕；他依靠旅舍、寺社、門樓與町巷作現成的據點，京都的街市本身就是一道不規則的牆。但他的兵力分散在首都周邊，情報靠驛馬傳遞，決策集中在一人之手，沒有縱深的預備隊，也沒有攻城的器械準備，一旦被拖長就只能靠縱火與夜襲維持嚇力。朝廷與唐軍的聯合行動則是另一種節奏：唐軍自海路抵近後由劉全真以唐兵與新羅、渤海兵為前鋒，用團隊作戰、弩箭齊射與長槍陣去啃街壘與門樓，大伴氏率畿內武人自西山道壓下，兩面夾擊，兵鋒不在攻城而在分割；同時切斷市內主要渡口、驛道與往大和的道路，把叛軍分割在町與鄉之間，令其無法互相策應。追擊階段由街壘戰轉為逐村搜索，大和國山間的村落一處一處被翻，仲麻呂的殘部在鄉間一處藏身之所被合圍，最後只餘數人，頭目自刃。後勤是這場戰爭成敗的關鍵：唐軍的糧秣靠海船運來，在筑紫、攝津一帶卸貨再以牛馬馱運入京，朝廷方靠諸國的調與京都周邊的兵糧接續。第一次遠征之所以無功而返，正是因為情報被切斷、無法就地取糧，第二次遠征有海路做補給線，再奪東京才有條件實現。
tacticsEn: The rebel method was sudden, ferocious and without depth. Nakamaro rose in the eighth month of Tenpyō Hōji 1, first seizing the palace precincts and gate towers with retainers from the Kyoto region, then setting fire to the official quarters around Takamatsu and the settlements around the Ōmiya palace, and holding the empress dowager as a banner so that a coup could be presented as a rescue of the sovereign. He used inns, temples, gate towers and the lanes of the town as ready-made strongpoints, for the city itself was an irregular wall. But his strength was scattered around the capital, intelligence travelled by relay horse, all decisions were centred on one man, and he had neither a reserve in depth nor siege equipment prepared, so once the fight was prolonged he had nothing but arson and night attacks to keep up the appearance of menace. The combined court-Tang operation ran on a different rhythm: after the fleet came in, Liu Quanzhen put Tang, Silla and Balhae troops in the van and worked on the street barricades and gate towers with drilled formations, crossbow volleys and long-spear ranks, while Ōtomo no Muraji drove the capital warriors down the western road and closed from the other side — the object being not to storm the city but to cut it into pieces, with the main crossings, the post roads and the road to Yamato blocked so that the rebels in the town and the rebels in the country could not support one another. In the pursuit the fight changed from barricades to a house-by-house search: the villages in the Yamato hills were turned over one after another, the remnants of Nakamaro were surrounded in a hiding place in the countryside, and the last few men were left with their chief, who cut himself down. Logistics decided the outcome. The Tang army's food came by sea, unloaded at Chikuzen and Settsu and then carried inland on oxen and horses, while the court drew on the provincial levies in kind and on the stores of the capital district. The first expedition failed and withdrew precisely because its lines of information were cut and it could not draw rations locally; the second had a sea line of supply, and only with that could the recapture of the Eastern Capital be made at all.
data: 時間：起兵在天平寶字元年八月，平定於同年九月，折合西曆762年9月至10月，全役前後約一個月。遠征次數：唐軍入日共兩次，第一次為天平勝寶二年（758）劉全真率唐兵與新羅、渤海兵自筑紫登陸，滯留到761年才撤回，第二次即本役。兵力：《續日本紀》記唐使劉全真與新羅、渤海及倭國兵眾合為十餘萬，但史家一般按數千至一萬的實際作戰兵力理解；船隊數目不詳。斬首數：史書記叛徒被斬首、梟首五百餘級；仲麻呂最後只餘數名隨從。距離：自筑紫、攝津一帶的登陸地到平安京，海路加陸路約六百至八百公里；平安京至奈良約四十公里，追擊縱深入大和山村。掌權時長：仲麻呂自741年藤原房內病故後掌權，至762年敗亡，前後約二十一年。善後：劉全真以安南大都護留鎮倭國，唐、新羅、渤海使節此後仍不斷到訪，日本的常備兵與遣唐使制度一直延續到九世紀，遣唐使則在894年告廢。
dataEn: Timing: the rising began in the eighth month of Tenpyō Hōji 1 and was settled in the ninth month of the same year, which is September to October 762 in the western calendar, so the whole campaign lasted about a month. Number of expeditions: Tang troops entered Japan twice, the first in Tenpyō Shōhō 2 (758), when Liu Quanzhen landed with Tang, Silla and Balhae troops in Chikuzen and stayed until withdrawing in 761; the second was this war. Strength: the Shoku Nihongi records the Tang envoy Liu Quanzhen with Silla, Balhae and Japanese contingents together as more than a hundred thousand men, but historians generally understand the actual combat strength as somewhere between several thousand and ten thousand; the number of ships is not recorded. Loss: the chronicles give more than five hundred rebel leaders beheaded or exposed on poles; Nakamaro was left with only a few followers. Distances: from the landing places in Chikuzen and Settsu to Heijō-kyō is roughly six hundred to eight hundred kilometres of sea and land; Heijō-kyō to Nara is about forty kilometres, and the pursuit ran deep into the mountain villages of Yamato. Duration of power: from the death of Fujiwara no Fuhito II in 741 to Nakamaro's fall in 762 is about twenty-one years of control. Aftermath: Liu Quanzhen was granted the title of grand protector of Annan and left in Japan with his troops, Tang, Silla and Balhae envoys continued to arrive, Japan's standing army and its envoys to Tang continued down into the ninth century, and the missions to Tang were finally abandoned in 894.
cause: 直接起因是一連串的喪事造成的權力真空。760年光明中宮去世，762年孝謙天皇駕崩，藤原氏在朝廷的兩根支柱先後消失，淳仁天皇於762年7月即位時還沒有自己的班底，仲麻呂的計劃是趁此廢掉淳仁、讓已退居上皇的孝謙復位，自己重新攝政；他把復辟說成是復元，把朝廷逼到只能求援於外的位置。而他的破綻出在家族內部：761年他廢自己女兒的中宮之位、改立淳仁之妻時，已經把妹妹光明皇太妃推到對立面，兩人的路線從此不可調和。762年7月，淳仁天皇前往皇太妃居所，皇太妃被僧侶禮僧挾持，企圖送入藤原宮由仲麻呂控制；她逃出後直入藤原宮，向逗留日本的唐使求援，於是唐兵由可望而不可即變成決定性的現存力量，舉兵的時機也隨之毀掉。遠因則在二十多年前：太師藤原房內秘密遣使唐廷求援，754年唐玄宗遣裴潛來日，757至758年第一批唐兵登陸日本；第一次遠征因仲麻呂封鎖信息、無法與朝廷接上頭而徒勞撤回，第二次遠征一到，仲麻呂就再也沒有等待的餘地。結構性的原因則是：他的權力建立在幕府式的私人網絡與近臣的人際控制上，靠的是壟斷情報與壟斷奏事，而不是國家軍隊；一旦宮禁被唐兵與大伴氏的實力穿透，這張網就沒有第二道防線。
causeEn: The immediate cause was a vacuum of power created by a run of deaths. Empress Kōmyō died in 760 and Emperor Shōtoku in 762, and the two props of the Fujiwara interest at court vanished in turn; when Emperor Junnin was enthroned in July 762 he had no team of his own, and Nakamaro's plan was to depose him in that situation, restore the retired Shōtoku, who had withdrawn as senior emperor, and take the regency again for himself; he dressed the restoration as a recovery of the rightful order and drove the court to the position of having to appeal to a foreign army. His own break came inside his family: when in 761 he deposed his daughter as empress and put Junnin's wife in her place, he had already driven his sister, the empress dowager Kōmyō, into opposition, and the two could not be reconciled after that. In July 762, when Junnin visited the empress dowager, the monk Rōsō seized her in a bid to carry her off to the Fujiwara palace and place her under Nakamaro's control; she escaped, took refuge in the Fujiwara palace and appealed to the Tang envoy then staying in Japan, so that the Tang troops went from something hoped for to the decisive force actually on the ground, and the moment for the rising was destroyed. The remote cause lay two decades earlier: Taishi Fujiwara no Fuhito II had secretly sent an embassy to the Tang court asking for help, the Tang envoy Pei Qian arrived in 754, and the first Tang troops landed in 757-758; that first expedition accomplished nothing because Nakamaro cut the lines of information and the troops could not get in touch with the court, and when the second expedition came there was no more time to wait for. The structural cause was that Nakamaro's power rested on a shogunal web of private patronage and of control over who had the emperor's ear — on a monopoly of information and of access — rather than on a state army, and once the palace precincts were pierced by Tang soldiers and by the Ōtomo warriors, that web had no second line of defence.
impact: 第一層影響是權力結構被重排。藤原氏在這場戰爭裡失去的中斷，是從此數十年不再出現在權力核心的直接起點：大伴氏憑平叛之功掌朝廷事務，直到九世紀初藤原氏才重新回到中樞位置；淳仁天皇762年即位、767年讓位給弟弟，而讓位之前被廢的孝謙曾企圖復辟，被以女主亂階的說法否定，於是女天皇不得為上皇成為定說，日本女皇傳統中關鍵的一步就此確立。第二層是對外格局：本役之後唐軍留駐日本，劉全真受授安南大都護，此後數十年日本以鎮兵的姿態倚賴唐與渤海、新羅的海上通道，遣唐使、渤海使密集往來，直到894年廢止遣唐使才告一段落，而唐軍的存在也讓日本貴族明白外援可以左右王位。第三層是兵權觀念的轉變：遠征的經驗使藤原氏把兵權視為禁區，後來在承和之變等事件中迅速收束武人的勢力，奈良時代對兵力的粗暴使用在此後被視為致亂之由。最後是戰後清算的殘酷一面：仲麻呂的封邑、財產與部眾被沒收入官，賞給有功將士，宗族勢力就此崩解，而765年底他在宮中仍被刺殺，說明這場戰爭並未真正終結——它只是把清算的時間延長了。
impactEn: The first layer of consequence is a rearrangement of the balance of power. The interruption of the Fujiwara house that this war produced is the direct starting point of their absence from the core of power for the following decades: the Ōtomo took charge of court affairs on the strength of their part in suppressing the revolt, and the Fujiwara only returned to the centre of government in the early ninth century. Junnin reigned from 762 and in 767 handed the throne to his younger brother, and before that handover the deposed Shōtoku had attempted a restoration that was refused on the grounds that a female sovereign must not become the retired emperor; the principle that a woman on the throne may not stand as sōkō was thereby established, one of the decisive steps in the Japanese tradition of female sovereigns. The second layer is external: after this war the Tang army stayed in Japan, Liu Quanzhen was granted the title of grand protector of Annan, and for several decades Japan leaned on the sea lanes to Tang, Balhae and Silla in the posture of a protected state, with missions to Tang and embassies from Balhae passing back and forth in numbers, until the missions to Tang were finally abandoned in 894. The presence of Tang troops also taught the Japanese aristocracy that foreign troops could decide who held the throne. The third layer is a change in how military power was thought about: the experience of the expeditions made the Fujiwara treat armed force as forbidden ground, and they closed in on the warrior clans in events such as the Jōwa no Hen; the rough use of troops in the Nara period came to be seen as a cause of disorder. Last is the harsh side of the settlement: Nakamaro's fiefs, wealth and dependents were confiscated and given to those who had served, the house was broken as a political force, and his murder in the palace at the end of 765 shows that the war had not really ended — it only extended the moment of reckoning.
result: 天平寶字元年八月起兵，九月平定，前後不過一個月。仲麻呂的失敗並非全因於戰術拙劣，而是敗在戰前的意外與戰力的懸殊：光明皇太妃逃出並向唐軍求援，使唐兵、新羅兵、渤海兵與朝廷的畿內武人合流，其總量遠超他臨時拼湊的私兵。追擊中，叛軍在京都與大和之間被道路與渡口切斷，節節敗退；仲麻呂本人在大和國的鄉間藏身之處被合圍，只剩數名隨從，遂服毒自刃，首級由追兵帶回京師。黨羽被斬首、梟首五百餘級，據《續日本紀》所記首級示於城外；其女、其孫與親信隨從被流放、誅殺或沒入官籍，女子甚至被配為官奴。光明皇太妃獲救，淳仁天皇穩住朝局，在位至767年；大伴氏因功受封賞，京畿武人第一次主導了對藤原氏一門的戰爭。唐兵第二次進入平安京，史家因此稱此役為再奪東京；劉全真受授安南大都護，留鎮倭國，成為此後數十年唐軍護日本的開端。
resultEn: The rising began in the eighth month of Tenpyō Hōji 1 and was settled in the ninth, a matter of about a month. Nakamaro's defeat was not simply a product of clumsy generalship, but of a mishap before the fighting and of a disparity of force: the empress dowager's escape and her appeal to the Tang army brought Tang, Silla and Balhae troops together with the capital warriors of the court, and their total far exceeded the private retainers he had hastily assembled. In the pursuit the rebels were cut off between Kyoto and Yamato by roads and river crossings and beaten back step by step. Nakamaro himself was surrounded in his hiding place in the villages of Yamato, with only a few followers left, and took poison rather than be taken; his head was carried back to the capital by his pursuers. His followers were beheaded and their heads displayed on poles, the chronicles saying more than five hundred; his daughter, his grandson and his close followers were exiled, executed or entered into official registers, and women among them were made official slaves. Empress Dowager Kōmyō was rescued, Junnin stabilised the court and reigned until 767, the Ōtomo were rewarded for their service, and the warriors of the capital region led a war against the Fujiwara house for the first time. Tang troops entered Heijō-kyō a second time, which is why the chronicles call this campaign the recapture of the Eastern Capital; Liu Quanzhen was granted the title of grand protector of Annan and left in Japan as garrison commander, the beginning of decades in which a Tang force stood over the country.
